question: Generality of the account under a second degradation. Hypothesis refined from the bicubic results: learned capacity acts where linear (bicubic) recovery is incomplete, not at a fixed u. Under a Gaussian-blur degradation (sigma = 0.6 s HR px, then bicubic resize without anti-aliasing) linear recovery is incomplete already below the LR Nyquist limit, so capacity should act there too.
training: LIIF 200 epochs, seed 1, recipe of v5 with the wrapper replaced by sr-implicit-downsampled-gauss (train and val). Arms: edsr, rdn, edsr-nocell.
eval: run_v3 with the LR made by the same gauss_down; DIV2K 0869-0900 centre 240; cell sweep.

predictions_frozen_before_training.G1_where: Across u-bins in [0,2) at x2,3,4: bins with RDN-minus-EDSR dR > 0.005 coincide with bins where the bicubic-upsampling R(u) under this degradation is < 0.9; agreement >= 80% of bins.
predictions_frozen_before_training.G2_below_nyquist: RDN-minus-EDSR dR > 0.005 in at least one bin with u < 0.75 at each of x2,3,4 (capacity acts below Nyquist when linear recovery is incomplete there).
predictions_frozen_before_training.G3_encoder_gain: RDN PSNR gain over EDSR > 0 at x2,3,4,6.
predictions_frozen_before_training.G4_cell: no-cell PSNR loss at x2 exceeds that at x4 and x6, and is <= 0.05 dB at x4 and x6.

compute: GPU0 A800: rdn; GPU1 A800: edsr then nocell (shared with other users' jobs).
